record_title: Pro-symmetric rings coincide with I-symmetric rings
provenance: A unit-group criterion identifies the projection-based pro-symmetric class with the pre-existing I-symmetric class of unital rings.
limitations: The full body of Han--Lee--Lee (DOI 10.1080/00927872.2022.2102177) was not inspected. Its abstract contains a closely related abelian-semiperfect special case, so hidden coverage of the unrestricted unit-group criterion is the principal residual originality risk. The 2019 symmetric-subset source and the relevant 2026 preprint statements were inspected. No independent validation is asserted.
